Anthropic says it cut CPU usage per request by about 70% and memory usage by more than 80% after migrating its Messages API from Python to Rust, with Claude writing much of the code.

Median time to first token also fell by about 20%, according to an Anthropic engineering blog post. The service stayed online throughout the switch.

Nvidia is reportedly cutting gaming GPU supply by another 20–30% this quarter, per Chinese distributor forum Board Channels.

RTX 50-series stock is already low, and distributors could face more price hikes. In China, GPU makers are steering distributors toward older RTX 3060 and 3050 cards.

name: unusual_whales
text:
BREAKING: Some employees at Anthropic and OpenAI reportedly don't want their newest AI models released at all, fearing they're too powerful to be safe, per Axios.

The debate now reaches the highest levels of both companies: whether to stop releasing frontier models to the public entirely and keep them locked away for internal use. Some reportedly want the companies to stop training new models altogether.
